transcription.text: A. Listen, then point and say.
The children are in a park.
Yau Yau can fly a kite.
Chen Chen can ride a bike.
Oi Hoi can run fast and help Chen Chen.
The children skip together, but Ting Ting can't skip.
I can't skip, but I can get some juice.
I can't fly up in the sky, but I can fly a kite up high.
I can't ride a bike at all, but I can play football.
I can skip and I can run and I can jump.
Hey, listen and circle, then talk.
Ting Ting, let's go to the park and have fun.
OK, I can play football with Dad.
I can't play football, but I can fly a kite.
We can fly a kite together.
You can skip with Mum too.
We have a lot of fun.
1, 2, 3, let's play a game of three.
1, 2, 3, let's all play you and me.
